roles.query: WITH decision_schema AS (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS decision_column_count FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) IN ('approved','rejected','approval_status','approval_decision','decision') OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%approval%') SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.loan_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS requested_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS funded_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(l.funded_amnt)/NULLIF(SUM(l.loan_amnt),0) AS decimal(12,8))) AS funding_ratio, d.decision_column_count AS approval_decision_column_count, CASE WHEN d.decision_column_count=0 THEN 'not_approval_rate' ELSE 'schema_requires_review' END AS semantic_verdict FROM loans_fact l CROSS JOIN decision_schema d GROUP BY d.decision_column_count
